---
name: Bug report (EN)
about: Something is broken or behaves oddly
title: "[BUG] "
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**What happens**
What you see, in a sentence or two.

**What you expected**
What should have happened instead.

**How to reproduce it**
The steps you took, if you can retrace them. Even a partial list helps.

**Screenshots**
If you have one of the app at that moment, it is worth a lot.

**Your setup**
- Windows version: [Windows 11, Windows 10]
- StreamyChat version and edition: [e.g. StreamyChat 0.9.0, or StreamyChat xD 0.9.0]

The version is written at the bottom left of the settings window.

**The report file**
Settings -> About -> **Report a bug** writes a ZIP with the logs, the session summary and
your settings, and opens the folder on it. Drag it into this form: it is what turns a report
into a fix. Your Twitch access tokens are stripped out of it.
